note: Carrying (Dave 2026-10-20, changed 2026-10-21): weight in kg per single item. by_id wins over by_suffix (an item id that ends with the word); anything else is default_kg. The most a body carries is carry_kg_per_body_kg x body weight (placeholder for strength; the server refuses to pick up more). Up to free_ratio (80 percent) of that limit nothing hinders at all: full speed, no extra effort. Above it you slow smoothly down to min_speed at the limit, and load_effort x fraction^load_effort_power (fraction 0 at 80 percent of the limit to 1 at the limit) is added to the effort of a moving player.
